text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S spoke to Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
A shining resolve, running to earn the 
title of a hero. She wanted to see that 
light up close once more. And so—she 
declared she would run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy's heart trembles with 
determination. She must accomplish the 
"Autumn Senior Triple Crown," even if she 
has to wager everything she has.
